entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Xavier 'Xavi' Marcos Padros is a Spanish Formula One chief race engineer for Cadillac Formula 1 Team.

Born in Spain, Padros began his career in motorsports at a young age, working his way up through various junior teams before joining Scuderia Ferrari in 2015.

As race engineer for Charles Leclerc from 2019 to May 2024, Padros played a pivotal role in the team's success, contributing to several podium finishes and helping Leclerc secure the 2020 Formula One World Championship.

Now with Cadillac, Padros continues to apply his expertise to the sport, pushing the boundaries of performance and innovation in Formula One.
